attributes.name: Call Weapon
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to search the deck of a character at your location for a weapon and draw it.

Bury this card to search the deck of a character at your location for a weapon and give it to any character.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 6 check to recharge this card instead of discarding or burying it.
